query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM calendar_accounts account
                WHERE account.sync_status IN ('pending', 'syncing')
                  AND (
                        account.owner_id = $1
                        OR EXISTS (
                            SELECT 1
                            FROM macro_user_links link
                            WHERE link.link_id = account.email_link_id
                              AND link.primary_macro_id = $1
                        )
                  )
            ) AS "is_syncing!"
